item.title: Bitcoin’s $63,000 zone emerges as key battleground for buyers: Glassnode
item.description: Retail investors and large whales are buying as bitcoin trades near its 200-week moving average.

item.title: At least 15 attackers exploited Coldcard vulnerability: Galaxy
item.description: Galaxy said that at least 15 different attackers have exploited the Coldcard vulnerability, which may have been avoided with just $2 worth of AI hardening, according to Dragonfly’s managing partner.

item.title: Polymarket targets $20 billion valuation as competition heats up in prediction market sector
item.description: The blockchain-based prediction markets platform is reportedly returning to investors months after a $15 billion funding round.

item.title: Intesa Sanpaolo slashed IBIT stake by 94% in 2Q, tripled ether ETF holding as crypto prices slumped
item.description: The Italian bank tripled its holding of iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF stake as total bitcoin ETF holdings fell 35% to $69.3 million.

item.title: Dinari brings tokenized U.S. stocks to American investors as equity race heats up
item.description: The move brings the custodial tokenization model to eligible U.S. investors as competition over blockchain-based equities intensifies.

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

item.title: Apple's AI Slop Problem Left a $200K macOS Exploit Unreported
item.description: A Milan start-up says it found a full-takeover flaw in macOS using ChatGPT, then hit Apple's new submission cap before it could file it.

item.title: Sorry everyone, Bitcoin is headed down to $43,500: Michael Terpin
item.description: Transform Ventures founder Michael Terpin says Bitcoin could have another 30% downside from its current price before he is confident the market has reached a bottom.

item.title: As Clarity Act teeters, mystery group hammers away at crypto in Washington ads
item.description: Crypto Watchdog has taken to warning people in DC about the hazards of digital assets, and its director won't say who is backing it.

item.title: BitGo’s WBTC move pushes LayerZero-to-Chainlink tally near $15 billion
item.description: A migration wave followed a $292 million Kelp bridge exploit, with announced LayerZero-to-Chainlink moves now totaling $14.5 billion.

item.title: Texas electric grid moratorium won’t have big impact on BTC miners: Bernstein
item.description: Monday’s announcement that Texas Governor Greg Abbott set a moratorium on approval of ERCOT-linked data centers pending an audit won’t impact miners’ approved electricity contracts.

item.title: Morning Minute: Saylor Sells Bitcoin Again
item.description: Strategy sold $104M in Bitcoin last week to help prop up STRC, a financial product they created to… help them buy more Bitcoin.

item.title: Tether Gold reserves rise 9.5% as gold posts worst quarter in 13 years
item.description: XAUt added to its bullion backing during gold’s worst quarter since 2013, as tokenized commodity holder counts continued to rise.

item.title: BNY to add crypto staking to digital asset custody platform
item.description: The custody bank has selected Galaxy to provide staking infrastructure as it broadens services for institutional crypto investors.

item.title: Coldcard urges users to move bitcoin as exploit is still in progress
item.description: The cold wallet maker said the flaw behind roughly $114 million in losses remains live, with specific models and firmware still exposed.

item.title: Italy’s biggest bank triples staked Ether ETF holdings while cutting IBIT shares
item.description: Italy’s largest bank Intesa Sanpaolo increased its staked Ether ETF position to $7.1 million while reducing its holdings in two spot Bitcoin ETFs.

item.title: BlackRock Tokenizes $311B of European Money Market Funds With JP Morgan's Kinexys

item.description: Your day-ahead look for Aug. 4, 2026

item.title: Jim Cramer plans to sell his Bitcoin over quantum fears as BTC rises 1.6%

item.title: Former FBI supervisor admits guilt in $1M crypto theft
item.description: A former FBI supervisory agent pleaded guilty to stealing about $1 million worth of digital assets from an adversarial country and forfeited about $925,000 in funds to government-controlled wallets.

item.title: BlackRock debuts tokenized access to $311 billion of money market funds in Europe
